lead: An error path only a non-`nvs run` context reaches still owes a case; `--RUN--` reaches it.
body: The gate wants the message cased, and `Core\Command::completions`'s refusal is reachable, not from a command line. `--RUN--\ntest\n` runs the file's `#[Test]` methods, so the case is a `#[Test]` echoing `$e->message`; an empty `--EXPECTF-ERROR--` claims the run failed.
